run_ppo_training_gaudi2: run PPO reinforcement learning training on a causal LM model using Intel Gaudi2 hardware
build_dataset_for_ppo: build a preprocessed dataset from stack-exchange-paired for PPO training with tokenized queries
configure_gaudi_ppo_trainer: configure a GaudiPPOTrainer with LoRA, reward model, and Gaudi2 acceleration settings
create_ppo_config_gaudi: create a GaudiPPOConfig with learning rate, batch size, KL control, and Habana settings
adapt_model_wrapper_gaudi: adapt the PreTrainedModelWrapper to work with Gaudi2 by calling adapt_PreTrainedModelWrapper_to_gaudi
